finalists.label: Graft-versus-host disease
finalists.why: It explains fulminant liver failure and hemodynamic shock with diffuse liver necrosis without vascular thrombosis or biliary leakage.

finalists.label: Rejection of transplanted liver
finalists.why: It accounts for cholestasis with worsening cytolysis and fulminant liver failure without any evidence against it.

finalists.label: Acute Rejection of Liver Transplant
finalists.why: It explains fulminant liver failure and hemodynamic shock with diffuse liver necrosis without vascular thrombosis or biliary leakage, similar to Graft-versus-host disease but more specific to liver transplant rejection.

frontier_selector.why: The evidence of fulminant liver failure and hemodynamic shock with diffuse liver necrosis without vascular thrombosis or biliary leakage, along with the specific context of a liver transplant, decided the final comparison in favor of Acute Rejection of Liver Transplant.
